t: This is Locking Piece, a sculpture by Henry Moore. The catalogue places it at the Henry Moore sculpture grounds at Perry Green. Moore is best known for his semi-abstract monumental bronze sculptures, found as public works of art around the world. He also produced many drawings, including a series depicting Londoners sheltering from the Blitz during the Second World War. If you're here, you're standing with the work of a sculptor whose pieces are scattered across many cities.
